note: BH-10122: the Archie chat log (bin/orc-context.sh, ORC_CONTEXT_LOG) that the chat-secret check scans with gitleaks dir --redact=100. Each record is scanned once; a key-shaped value is one chat-secret finding that names the record time, the part (message or reply), the line and the rule, never the value. Empty = no chat scan. A missing file or a path that is not a regular file (a symlink is refused) is one log line and no scan. Under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 with this unset, the scan is off. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane reads.
